cards.text: Friend, Jonah is a prophet (2 Kings 14:25). The LORD once told him to go to Nineveh, and he ran away from the LORD instead (Jonah 1:2-3). After a great fish vomited him onto dry land (Jonah 2:10), the word of the LORD comes to Jonah a second time.
God tells Jonah to get up, go to the great city of Nineveh, and proclaim the message He gives him. Friend, after YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, I'm the PRESIDENT of the Second Chance Club.

cards.question: This time, Jonah gets up and goes to Nineveh, just as the LORD said.
Nineveh is an exceedingly great city. It's so big that it requires a ___ journey.

cards.text: On the first day of his journey, Jonah heads into the city and proclaims, “Forty more days and Nineveh will be overturned!” Friend, I've opened fortune cookies with longer messages than that.

cards.question: Jonah says Nineveh has forty more days. How do the people of Nineveh respond?

cards.text: And they don't just nod along, friend. The Ninevites proclaim a fast and dress in sackcloth.

cards.question: When the Ninevites fast and dress in sackcloth, who joins in?

cards.text: Everybody's in, the WHOLE city, like a group chat where everybody actually replies. Then word reaches the king of Nineveh.
The king gets up from his throne, takes off his royal robe, and covers himself with sackcloth too.

cards.question: After the king of Nineveh leaves his throne and puts on sackcloth, where does he sit?

cards.text: From the throne to the ashes, friend, that's not a step down, that's the WHOLE staircase. Then the king issues a proclamation in Nineveh.

cards.question: The king and his nobles issue a decree in Nineveh. Under it, the herds and flocks must not eat or drink either.
The king says man and beast must both be covered with sackcloth, and everyone must call out earnestly to God. What does he say each one should turn from?
The king tells the people that God will surely spare them.

cards.text: The king says, “Who knows? God may turn and relent; He may turn from His fierce anger, so that we will not perish.” Then God sees their actions, that they have turned from their evil ways.

cards.question: God sees that Nineveh has turned from its evil ways. What does He do?

answers.text: He delays it for a year

cards.text: Hang your apron up for now, friend, but don't get comfortable. This story is NOT done yet.
